title: SG-4.1.2 Lock phaser to 3.90.x in package-lock.json
summary: package-lock.json resolves phaser 3.90.0 to match package.json ~3.90.0
description: Context: game/frontend/package.json already declares phaser ~3.90.0, but game/frontend/package-lock.json still lists the root phaser specifier as ^4.2.1 and node_modules/phaser as 4.2.1. Desired behavior: the lockfile agrees with package.json. Expected result: npm ci installs phaser 3.90.0. Why: Phaser 3.90 is the required engine version and the lockfile is out of sync.
acceptance_criteria: Given package-lock.json, when packages[""].dependencies.phaser is read, then it equals ~3.90.0 and package.json's phaser value.
Given package-lock.json, when packages["node_modules/phaser"] is read, then version is 3.90.0 with the 3.90.0 tarball URL and its integrity hash.
Given the lockfile unit tests, when run against the real file, then they pass and would fail on 4.2.1.
definition_of_done: Lockfile phaser entries describe 3.90.0 and tests pass
